calls.title: GrowthBook Canada EOR
calls.summary: The team convened to expedite the offer for a Canadian EOR hire despite uncertainties around deposit fees. Jennifer confirmed the hiring manager's wish to send the offer letter immediately, with a $75 fee and a discounted monthly rate of approximately $480. The zero deposit policy was reviewed for its applicability to current and future hires. Smooth onboarding was emphasized, with the contract requiring CEO Graham's signature amid time zone challenges. A promotional offer of four free months of EOR service for VC-backed companies was discussed, initiating one month free now and the rest at renewal in May. The target start date for the Canadian hire is March 30, allowing for contract and onboarding preparations.
calls.keywords: Canadian EOR, zero deposit, offer letter, EOR fee discount, VC-backed promotion, onboarding process
